checks.why: a fixture star-imported into conftest.py is that conftest's fixture, and reaches the tests that request it (#1537)
a fixture of a module named in pytest_plugins reaches every test that requests it, in any directory (#1537)
@pytest.fixture(name=...) is requested by the declared name, and the def name requests nothing (#1539)
a module-level fixture reaches the tests in its file that request it, not every test in the file (#1527)
an argument the test parametrizes directly is not a request for the fixture of that name (#1529)
a usefixtures marker on a class reaches the tests the class holds, and not a sibling class's (#1528)
a sibling directory's conftest, star import and all, is not visible here
an argument handed to the fixture with indirect=True still requests it (control for #1529)
a fixture a class declares wins over the module fixture it overrides for that class's tests (#1512)
the class fixture serves its own class's tests only (control for #1512)
a fixture named test_* is not a test, and conftest.py is never collected (#1531)
a module's pytestmark usefixtures reaches the tests of that module only (#1528)
the ini usefixtures option reaches every test that can see the fixture, and not a sibling directory's (#1528)
a pytestmark marker naming a pytest_plugins module's fixture reaches the module's tests (#1528, #1537)
a marker naming a star-imported fixture reaches the tests below that conftest, not a sibling directory's (#1537)
